title: PRD-06 Tame folding line
summary: Closed cost centre for the Tame folding line in unit NBC-MAN-01, decommissioned on 2025-03-31.
body:
Cost centre PRD-06 covered the Tame folding line in manufacturing unit NBC-MAN-01 under owner DOKAFOR [^r1]. The cost centre is closed and has been inactive since its closure on 2025-03-31 [^r1]. No active purchase requisitions, orders, or operational expenses may be charged to this cost centre today [^r1].
